split_policy: entire future target support; Train2025, Validation2026Q1, Test2026Apr-Aug; crossing windows dropped
benchmark_claim: retrospective forecast-vintage replay; first public ND/forecast availability unverified
source_change_policy: removed Jan-Jun ID must be recorded; use current official full-year2026 resource only if raw coverage supplies both required holdouts; do not fabricate missing vintages
scheduler: constant learning rate as supplied NESO adapter
selection_stage1: sample-weighted original latent loss on fixed chronological Validation batches
selection_stage2: sample-weighted decoded MAE on fixed chronological Validation batches, label-free predictive path
primary_online_metric: MAE in MW on identical unfinished target slots after B
updater_gate: B1 improves B0 MAE by>=1%, seven-day descriptive interval favors B1, >=2/3 seven-day blocks improve, and B3 is worse than B1 by>1%; all measured on Validation only
updater_model: supplied single-step LatentRevisionUpdater only; original WorldTS frozen
test_gate: freeze configuration, calibration, model selection and updater decision in validation_decision_lock.json; verify file hashes before one final replay
go_rule: updater must show stable>=1% Validation MAE gain over both B1 and B3, or accuracy within1% of best with>=2x incremental speedup when full recompute p95 exceeds100ms; final Test confirms locked comparison, never selects settings
no_go_rule: negligible revision headroom, simple correction already sufficient, or cheap recomputation with no updater accuracy advantage; retain negative findings
